byog.subtitle: Contribute your idle GPU/CPU compute power to earn tokens or run private local workloads.
byog.connect_new_compute_node_desc: Run our ultra-lightweight worker daemon on your Desktop, Laptop, or Mobile device to start earning.
byog.pairing_code_instructions: Enter the 16-character code shown on your worker terminal (e.g., 9K4L-28XM-73PQ-51ZR) or scan the QR code.
byog.qr_pairing_hint: Scan this QR code from the mobile worker application to pair instantly.
byog.share_setup_link: Download the worker client for your platform:
byog.pair_failed_toast: Failed to pair device. Please check the code.
byog.enter_pairing_code_error: Please enter a valid pairing code.
byog.no_nodes_connected_desc: You haven't paired any compute nodes yet. Click 'Pair New Device' to connect your first GPU or CPU.
byog.configure_node_desc: Adjust operating mode, power schedule, and resource allocations for this node.
byog.confirm_delete_device: Are you sure you want to remove this compute node? All active worker tasks will be disconnected.
byog.operating_mode_desc: Choose whether to earn tokens by contributing to the community network or reserve this node for private local models.
byog.mode_b_desc: Process public requests from the decentralized network and earn tokens based on speed and uptime.
byog.power_schedule_matrix_desc: Configure working hours and throttling behavior to prevent performance degradation while gaming or working.
byog.profile_full_power_desc: Maximum performance and multiplier. Best for dedicated rigs and servers.
byog.profile_half_power_desc: Runs at 50% power cap to keep fans silent and reduce heat.
byog.profile_active_hours_desc: Runs full power during specified off-peak hours (e.g. 00:00 - 08:00) with +30% night bonus.
byog.profile_dual_schedule_desc: Adaptive power profile automatically switching between daytime and nighttime limits.
byog.resource_allocation_desc: Adjust sliders to allocate system resources. Higher allocations increase your multiplier prestige badge.
byog.mobile_governance_desc: Strict battery, thermal, and cellular policies designed to protect mobile hardware.
byog.charging_only_desc: Inference occurs only when the device is plugged into AC power (default: OFF).
byog.reward_store_description: Redeem your earned compute tokens for premium software licenses, gaming items, and gift cards.
byog.confirm_claim_desc: This will deduct {{tokens}} tokens from your account and automatically open a support ticket for fulfillment.
byog.claim_auto_ticket_explanation: A support ticket will be generated upon confirmation so our team can deliver your digital code or shipping details.
byog.claim_error: Failed to claim reward. Please check your token balance.
byog.insufficient_balance: Insufficient token balance to claim this item.
byog.zero_trust_policy_explanation: This node failed zero-trust canary validation or deterministic probability audits. To protect network integrity, computation has been halted.
byog.appeal_modal_description: Explain your hardware configuration or why this verification failure was in error. A support ticket will be created for admin review.
byog.appeal_placeholder: Describe the environment, driver versions, or modifications...
byog.appeal_text_required: Please enter an explanation for your appeal.
byog.admin.page_description: Comprehensive administration for decentralized compute network, hardware allocation rules, virtual models, and telemetry.
byog.admin.global_toggle_desc: Master switch to enable or disable the entire BYOG compute network, user tabs, community model routing, and worker connections globally.
byog.admin.load_settings_failed: Failed to load BYOG admin settings.
byog.admin.pricing_matrix_desc: Set provider payout rates and customer charges per 1,000,000 tokens based on latency and throughput tiers.
byog.admin.network_parameters_desc: Configure JIT cold-start timeouts and global multiplier surge windows.
byog.admin.max_cold_start_timeout_hint: Maximum seconds to wait for worker model load before falling back to cloud channels.
byog.admin.night_owl_surge_desc: Automatically grant +30% token boost between 00:00 and 08:00 local time.
byog.admin.weekend_crunch_desc: Automatically grant +20% token boost during Saturday and Sunday.
byog.admin.hardware_backends_desc: Enable or disable specific GPU, NPU, and CPU acceleration engines across the network.
byog.admin.assignment_rules_desc: Define rule-based policies to assign specific models to connected devices based on physical RAM, VRAM, and instruction sets.
byog.admin.rule_dialog_desc: Specify matching criteria and target models to automatically download on matching worker nodes.
byog.admin.target_models_hint: Comma-separated list of model IDs to download automatically.
byog.admin.confirm_delete_rule: Are you sure you want to delete this assignment rule?
byog.admin.models_loras_desc: Manage base GGUF model files, multi-chunk manifests, and hot-swappable LoRA adapters.
byog.admin.no_loras_attached: No LoRA adapters attached to this base model.
byog.admin.base_model_dialog_desc: Configure model endpoint ID, download manifests, and zero-trust anti-cheat exams.
byog.admin.confirm_delete_model: Are you sure you want to delete this model?
byog.admin.confirm_delete_lora: Are you sure you want to delete this LoRA adapter?
byog.admin.connected_nodes_desc: Live inventory of all worker machines connected to the BYOG network.
byog.admin.banned_nodes_desc: Worker machines suspended due to anti-cheat canary failures or deterministic verification anomalies.
byog.admin.confirm_unban: Are you sure you want to unban this compute node?
byog.admin.load_banned_failed: Failed to load banned nodes list.
byog.admin.pending_claims_desc: Verify user token generation history and fulfill requested digital or physical rewards.
byog.admin.confirm_reject_claim: Are you sure you want to reject this claim? Burned tokens will be refunded.
byog.admin.catalog_desc: Configure goods, licenses, and gift cards available for token redemption.
byog.admin.no_items_in_catalog: No items in reward catalog. Click 'Add Reward Item' to create one.
byog.admin.reward_dialog_desc: Configure title, required token burn, and stock availability.
byog.admin.confirm_delete_reward: Are you sure you want to delete this reward item?

byog.admin.multiplier_high_tps_desc: Bonus awarded to worker nodes delivering sustained throughput exceeding 40 Tokens Per Second.
byog.admin.multiplier_sub_second_ttft_de: Incentive granted when Time To First Token is under 1.0 second for ultra-responsive streaming.
byog.admin.multiplier_high_uptime_desc: Reward for nodes maintaining continuous network availability for 7 or more consecutive days.
byog.admin.multiplier_super_uptime_desc: Top-tier reliability bonus for nodes connected without interruption for 30 or more days.
byog.admin.multiplier_residential_ip_des: Boost applied to residential broadband nodes to broaden geographical decentralization and anti-datacenter diversity.
byog.admin.multiplier_gigabit_fiber_desc: Bonus for high-bandwidth nodes with >= 1000 Mbps download and >= 500 Mbps upload speeds.
byog.admin.multiplier_low_latency_desc: Reward for low latency edge nodes with ping times strictly below 30ms.
byog.admin.multiplier_clean_reputation_d: Bonus awarded to nodes maintaining a flawless 100/100 reputation score without failed audits.
byog.admin.multiplier_battery_eco_desc: Safety multiplier for mobile and tablet nodes running while plugged in with battery temps below 38°C.
byog.admin.multiplier_weekend_crunch_des: Surge multiplier active throughout weekends to support peak compute loads.
